# Supabase browser client

`supabase.js` is the official UMD distribution of `@supabase/supabase-js` version **2.119.0**.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.0/dist/umd/supabase.js

The package's MIT license is included as `SUPABASE-LICENSE.txt`. This pinned local copy avoids loading a changing CDN script at runtime. Upgrade it deliberately and rerun the tests.
